_note: FA 2026 First Schedule Part I-B Paragraph A item (II) (gazette p.85): "every individual, being a resident in India, who is of the age of sixty years or more but less than eighty years at any time during the tax year". Selected in place of RATE-SLAB-FIRST-SCHEDULE when its conditions hold (D-072). Spans TY 2025-26 (W-052c, D-082): FA 2026 First Schedule Part I-A Paragraph A (p.80), the 1961-Act rates for AY 2026-27, states the same bands, with "previous year" for Part I-B's "tax year". provision1961 corrected from "Income-tax Act, 1961 First Schedule": the 1961 Act does not state these rates.
